changelog: Airbus fleet database updated for A320, A321neo, A330-300 and A350-900
Aircraft registration assignment now stays inside the correct aircraft family
Route aircraft weighting added for Phuket, Thai domestic routes, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, India and long-haul flights
Turnaround departure times are more varied while preserving at least 12h rest between separate duties
Messages UI updated with corporate buttons, English dates, multi-select deletion and persistent deleted state
Hidden 5-tap next-month test flow can now generate and clear the next-month draft
